actions.action: Finger test soil moisture 2-3 cm deep
Slide plant out and inspect roots
Scrape off top 1-2 cm of moldy soil and discard, wipe pot rim
Repot into container with drainage holes using fresh well-draining mix
If roots are mushy, trim rotten parts with clean scissors
Water only when top few cm are dry and let excess drain
Move plant to a bright spot with air movement
Remove dead or badly yellowed leaves

reason: The answer identifies surface mold from overly wet soil as the main cause and recommends repotting into fresh soil, matching the poster's fix, with no harmful advice.
